name: t0kns
title: t0kns
description: Check your AI coding subscription limits and when they reset
author: jnk

commands.name: check-ai-limits
commands.title: Check AI Limits
commands.description: See remaining subscription quota and reset times for your AI coding tools.

commands.name: quick-check
commands.title: Quick Limit Check
commands.description: Shows your remaining AI subscription limits in a brief overlay. Assign it a hotkey for a one-key check.

preferences.name: hudFormat
preferences.title: HUD Format
preferences.description: Smart shows your primary limit's remaining percentage and expands for low quota or usage ahead of elapsed time, with reset countdowns. All Windows shows all account-wide limits.

preferences.name: codexEnabled
preferences.title: Codex
preferences.label: Show Codex limits
preferences.description: Read Codex subscription limits through the locally installed Codex CLI.

preferences.name: codexPath
preferences.title: Codex Executable
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to the codex executable. Leave empty to search common install locations.

preferences.name: codexHome
preferences.title: Codex Home (Advanced)
preferences.description: Optional absolute path used as CODEX_HOME for a custom Codex profile. Leave empty to use Codex's default.

preferences.name: claudeEnabled
preferences.title: Claude Code (Experimental)
preferences.label: Show Claude Code limits
preferences.description: Read Claude subscription limits through the locally installed Claude Code CLI. Uses an experimental Claude Code interface that may change without notice.

preferences.name: claudePath
preferences.title: Claude Executable
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to the claude executable. Leave empty to search common install locations.

preferences.name: claudeConfigDir
preferences.title: Claude Config Folder (Advanced)
preferences.description: Optional absolute path used as CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR for a custom Claude Code profile. Leave empty to use Claude Code's default.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
